import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Combine date and time to create a proper datetime object
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
# Extract the hour for time-of-day analysis
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour

# --- Data Aggregation for Plots ---
# 1. Sales by Hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# 2. Top 7 Products by Revenue
top_products = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(7).sort_values(ascending=True)

# 3. Sales by Customer Age Group
age_order = ['<18', '18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)

# 4. Sales by Payment Method and Takeaway Status
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
payment_takeaway.rename(columns={0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'}, inplace=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 14))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=24, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# Define a color palette
palette_deep = sns.color_palette("deep")
palette_viridis = sns.color_palette("viridis_r", n_colors=len(top_products))

# Plot 1: Peak Sales Hours (Bar Plot)
sns.barplot(data=hourly_sales, x='hour', y='total', ax=axs[0, 0], color=palette_deep[0], alpha=0.9)
axs[0, 0].set_title('Peak Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axs[0, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (24h format)', fontsize=12)
axs[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axs[0, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))

# Plot 2: Top 7 Products by Revenue (Horizontal Bar Plot)
top_products.plot(kind='barh', ax=axs[0, 1], color=palette_viridis, width=0.8)
axs[0, 1].set_title('Top 7 Products by Revenue', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axs[0, 1].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axs[0, 1].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axs[0, 1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))

# Plot 3: Revenue by Customer Age Group (Bar Plot)
age_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=axs[1, 0], color=sns.color_palette("plasma", n_colors=len(age_sales)), width=0.8)
axs[1, 0].set_title('Revenue from Customer Age Groups', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axs[1, 0].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=12)
axs[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axs[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axs[1, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))

# Plot 4: Revenue by Payment Method (Stacked Bar Plot)
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axs[1, 1], color=[palette_deep[2], palette_deep[3]], width=0.8)
axs[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Breakdown (Dine-in vs. Takeaway)', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axs[1, 1].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
axs[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axs[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
axs[1, 1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('${x:,.0f}'))
axs[1, 1].legend(title='Order Type')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
